name: 20261018140340_link_provider_playlists
sql:
UPDATE `playlist` SET
  `link` = json_object(
    'provider', substr(`origin`, 9),
    'remoteId', (SELECT `remote_id` FROM `library_remote_playlist` WHERE `playlist_id` = `playlist`.`id`),
    'direction', 'import'
  ),
  `hlc` = printf('%015d', max(
    CAST(substr(`hlc`, 1, 15) AS INTEGER) + 1,
    CAST((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER)
  )) || '-0000-' || (SELECT `replica_id` FROM `replica_identity` WHERE `slot` = 1),
  `field_hlc` = NULL,
  `change_seq` = (SELECT `change_seq` FROM `replica_identity` WHERE `slot` = 1)
WHERE `origin` LIKE 'account:%' AND `deleted` = 0
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `library_remote_playlist` WHERE `playlist_id` = `playlist`.`id`);

name: 20261019104249_replicate_provider_account
sql: ALTER TABLE `provider_account` ADD `deleted` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL;

-- Existing rows get an HLC from their link time, so that the default never stays
ALTER TABLE `provider_account` ADD `hlc` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `provider_account` ADD `change_seq` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;

-- A new `change_seq`, so that paired replicas pull the existing accounts
UPDATE `replica_identity` SET `change_seq` = `change_seq` + 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `provider_account`);
